intro.h2: From catch-all storage room to a space you want to use
paragraphs: Robert Repairs LLC handles home repairs and remodeling in Knoxville, TN, with a focus on making tired rooms look finished. One client hired Robert to clad the walls of what she called a terribly ugly basement entry room. He did it in less than ideal conditions, and the old catch-all storage area may now become her mud room.

Robert pays attention to the details, too. Another client says he was punctual and detail-oriented and made sure everything was sturdy and perfectly aligned. We are open every day of the week from 8 AM to 8 PM, so it is easy to reach us when the project is on your mind.

services.h2: What Robert Repairs can do for you

items.name: Wall paneling and room makeovers
items.blurb: Robert clads walls in clean white paneling with trim. For one client he turned a dark, cluttered basement entry into a bright room that may now become her mud room. She says it turned out to be a beautiful addition to her home.

about.text: Robert Repairs LLC is run by Robert and serves Knoxville, TN and the surrounding areas. The business covers home repairs, wall paneling, painting, flooring and smaller jobs like furniture assembly, plus kitchen and bathroom updates. Robert replies to his Google reviews personally and tells clients they can always count on him. Reviews describe someone who shows up on time, pays attention to the details and stays in touch after the job. After one basement entry makeover, he was already looking forward to coming back for the client's flooring.

service_area.h2: Home repairs and remodeling in Knoxville, TN
service_area.text: Robert Repairs LLC serves Knoxville, TN and the surrounding areas. We come to you, so there is no shop to visit. Whether it is a basement room, a wall that needs paneling, a floor, a paint job or a piece of furniture to assemble, call (865) 276-7363 any day between 8 AM and 8 PM and tell us where you are.

items.q: What kinds of jobs do you take?
items.a: Home repairs and remodeling around Knoxville: wall cladding and paneling, room makeovers, house painting, flooring, furniture assembly, and kitchen and bathroom updates. If you are not sure whether your job fits, call (865) 276-7363 and describe it, and Robert will tell you.

We are open seven days a week, Sunday through Saturday, from 8 AM to 8 PM. That makes it easy to call in the evening or on a weekend. Reach Robert at (865) 276-7363, or email robertsissonrepairs@gmail.com with a short description of the job.

items.q: Can you fix up a basement or storage room?
items.a: Yes. One client hired Robert to clad the walls of an ugly basement entry room that had become a catch-all storage area. He did it in less than ideal conditions, and she says the room turned out to be a beautiful addition that may now become a mud room.

We serve Knoxville, TN and the surrounding areas, and we come to your home for the work. If you live outside Knoxville and are not sure whether you are in range, call (865) 276-7363 with your town and a short description of the project.

Yes. Not every job is a remodel. One client hired Robert just to assemble a dresser and says he was punctual, put everything together quickly and made sure it was sturdy and perfectly aligned. Small jobs often lead to the next project on your list.

final_cta.h2: Have a room you have been putting off?
final_cta.text: Call Robert any day from 8 AM to 8 PM and tell him what you have in mind.
